arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.SOC,
    f."Academic Year",
    s.School,
    f."School Name",
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)",
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    ROUND(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)", 6) AS calculated_rate,
    ROUND(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 6) AS stored_rate
FROM main.frpm AS f
JOIN main.schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC, f.CDSCode
LIMIT 6
